semantic_contract.task_statement: Develop a process for multiplying two matrices.

result.canonical_semantics: Matrix product A×B for compatible dimensions.

semantic_contract.human_review_instruction: Judge the original generated pseudocode against this same frozen task-semantic contract, including when automated evaluation is NOT_EVALUABLE.

declared_evidence_summary: This suite retains the three previously frozen compatible matrix-product cases as core behavioural evidence. Explicit 1×1 and identity cases are retained as provisional pre-freeze validation cases after the RC9 baseline regression and do not affect calibration or experimental core scores. Incompatible dimensions remain a separate semantic-boundary probe.
coverage_basis: Core scoring is based on the 3 previously frozen seeded Common Test cases. Two additional valid-domain matrix cases are retained in PRE_FREEZE_VALIDATION and are excluded from core scoring until explicitly baseline-validated. Semantic-boundary probes remain separately descriptive.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret core behavioural accuracy only from CORE_BEHAVIOURAL cases. PRE_FREEZE_VALIDATION cases are candidate valid-domain expansions retained for baseline validation and must not affect calibration or experimental core scoring. Interpret Semantic Boundary Variance separately as descriptive out-of-domain evidence.
coverage_limitations: 1×1 and identity-product cases are candidate valid-domain coverage expansions but remain provisional until the established baseline validates their invocation/observation semantics.
Incompatible inner dimensions are outside the matrix-product contract and are reported separately through semantic-boundary variance.
